A weekly series built from public IRS data on Utah's 13,072 tax-exempt organizations. Each post takes one finding (about boards, funding, finances, or how organizations describe their impact) and asks what it says about analytics maturity.

Want to know where your own organization stands? [Take the short analytics maturity assessment](https://clarkruttinger.info/assessment/?src=blog).
